description: The Hover-1 Stealth is a seamless blend of style, performance, and convenience for urban commuters and leisure riders alike. Crafted with a lightweight yet durable frame, this E-Scooter is built to withstand the rigors of daily use while remaining agile and easy to maneuver. Powered by a high torque 500W brushless motor, Stealth delivers swift acceleration and an impressive 20 mph top speed, allowing riders to effortlessly tackle inclines and quickly get to where they want to go. Equipped with a removable battery, Stealth can be quickly and conveniently charged in tight spaces without needing to lug the entire E-Scooter to an outlet! It also folds down for easy storage and carrying. Ride for up to 30 miles to enjoy extended journeys or tackle longer commutes. High performance front and rear disc brakes provide responsive stopping power, and a bright LED headlight and taillight ensure visibility in low-light conditions. The 10” tubeless tires and dual front shock suspension system cushions you from bumps and road imperfections, greatly enhancing ride quality. Ride into the night with the Hover-1 Stealth!
